name: many-faces-outdoor-shopify-theme
description: Shopify Online Store 2.0 theme for The Outdoor Estate, built from catalog.json and the planner layer

scripts.build: node posters.mjs && node ../tools/shopify-catalog.mjs && node build.mjs && node planner/build.mjs && node planner/docs.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs planner/tests/*.test.mjs
